name: print-social-studio-services-ad-desk-scene
title: Design studio services ad with desk scene and giant headline
whatItIs: A square ad on blue: a glowing white arch shape frames a desk with a monitor and chair, with a huge 'Next Project' headline in black and grey, a list of services in small text and contact icons at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Professional and approachable; the desk scene tells people this is where work gets done.
techniques: Use a lit stage shape (arch) behind a scene to focus the eye on the headline.
Pair a huge two-line headline with a small services list for scanning.
Group contact handles in a row at the base.
Keep the palette to brand blue, white and black.

vocabulary.definition: A bright geometric form behind the subject as a spotlight.
A compact line of offerings under a headline.
Icons and handles arranged in a strip.
Making the main phrase dominate the layout.
